caseNameFull: Charles C. Hobart Father and Next Friend of Elizabeth Beatrice Hobart v. Rachel Elizabeth Hobart
attorneys: Baird, Broomhall, William M. Harrelson and Richard Wilson for appellant., C. V. Diedel and Frank E. Basler for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
